subject: Teamwork
content: Team innovation is creating new ideas, products, or processes through collaboration. Innovation types: incremental (small improvements to existing products), breakthrough (radical new solutions), disruptive (new technology that replaces old). Innovation process: generate ideas (brainstorming, customer feedback), screen ideas (feasibility, potential), develop concept (prototype, test), implement (launch, scale), learn (feedback, iterate). Team conditions for innovation: psychological safety (safe to share unusual ideas), diversity (different perspectives), autonomy (freedom to explore), resources (time, tools, budget), support (leadership encouragement), reward (recognition for ideas, even failed ones). Nigerian team innovations: Paga (mobile payments), Flutterwave (payment processing), Andela (remote tech talent), BudgIT (government budget transparency), FarmCrowdy (agriculture tech). Student team innovation: project improvements, new club activities, event planning, problem-solving for school issues. Innovation requires persistence; most ideas fail before success.
summary: Team innovation = creating new ideas, products, processes. Types: incremental, breakthrough, disruptive. Process: generate, screen, develop, implement, learn. Conditions: safety, diversity, autonomy, resources, support.
